title: Ensemble Machine Learning Approaches for Breast Cancer Prediction: A Comprehensive Analysis with SMOTE and LASSO Feature Selection

contributions.purpose: 在生活方式/饮食特征上系统评测六种集成模型预测乳腺癌
contributions.mechanism: 334 样本 15 特征,中位数插补+SMOTE 平衡+LASSO 选特征,对 RF/GB/XGBoost/AdaBoost/ExtraTrees/Voting 做 5 折交叉验证,评 accuracy/precision/recall/F1/ROC-AUC
contributions.evaluation: Voting Classifier 最优:accuracy 93.0%、precision 91.0%、recall 95.0%、F1 93.0%、ROC-AUC 96.0%;XGBoost 次优(92.0%/95.0%)
contributions.domain: 医学机器学习 / 乳腺癌预测
contributions.source_quote: The Voting Classifier achieved the highest performance with 93.0% accuracy, 91.0% precision, 95.0% recall, 93.0% F1-score, and 96.0% ROC-AUC.

contributions.purpose: 用 LASSO 做特征选择与降维
contributions.mechanism: L1 正则(λ=0.023,10 折 CV 定)从 15 特征选出 10 个,VIF<5,并做 100 次 bootstrap 稳定性分析
contributions.evaluation: 选出 top10(运动频率系数 0.45、水果摄入 0.38、家族史 0.35 等);8/10 特征在 100 次 bootstrap 中稳定,运动频率/水果摄入稳定分 0.94/0.91
contributions.source_quote: LASSO regularization successfully identified 10 most significant features from the original 15 features through cross-validated optimization.

contributions.purpose: 用 SMOTE 处理类别不平衡
contributions.mechanism: 对少数类插值合成样本平衡数据集(原始 184 cases/150 controls,55.1%/44.9%)
contributions.evaluation: 作者称平衡后各模型 precision/recall 更均衡,支撑医学 ML 需平衡数据的既往结论
contributions.source_quote: The Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) was implemented to address class imbalance issues.

notes: desk-reject;严重质量红旗:全文所有图(Fig 1-5)均为空白占位框显示 "Show Image",图片未嵌入;Author Contributions 段为空白;非匿名(致谢点名 Sri Eshwar College of Engineering),违反双盲。无 Agents4Science AI Involvement/Paper Checklist、无任何 AI 参与披露(desk-reject 主因)。方法学疑点:334 样本极小却报出异常齐整且高的指标(所有值均为整 0.5% 步长,SD<2%);"生活方式/饮食因素预测乳腺癌"的数据集来源不明、无 ROC/SHAP 实图支撑;先 SMOTE 后交叉验证若在划分前过采样会致数据泄漏(文中未澄清顺序)。self_declared_provenance 空。无编号贡献列表使用引言 four contributions,归纳为 3 条(SMOTE 与 LASSO 各独立成条,模型评测合并)。
